Frontend (390x844): logged in as garden_test -> Contractors tab -> first contractor (GreenThumb Landscapes) shows draft-contract + my-agreements testIDs -> draft-contract opens chooser -> draft-no-project creates contract and navigates to /contract/{id}. My Agreements list correctly reflects statuses (Awaiting signatures / Completed / Draft) and prices per contract. No red screens, only carry-over 'shadow*' / props.pointerEvents deprecation warnings (non-blocking). Deprecated packages check: none introduced by this feature.

integration_issues.flow: Hard-nav / direct link to authenticated screen (e.g. /contract/{id}, /contracts) after page reload
integration_issues.issue: ContractScreen and ContractsList fire their initial apiFetch in useEffect on mount without awaiting AuthContext's loading state. On a fresh tab (hard reload), the fetch races AuthProvider's loadToken() and gets 401, then the screen either renders 'Not authenticated' (contract detail) or shows the empty-state 'No agreements yet' permanently (contracts list) even though the user IS logged in. Reproducible: login as admin, then page.goto('/contracts') or /contract/{id}. Not a blocker for normal in-app SPA navigation (all UI tested via tab/link flow works). Fix: gate the load() effect on !loading && user, or retry once when auth becomes ready.

issues: Non-blocking: react-native-web 'shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings persist (carry-over from v6).

action_items: Fix auth-bootstrap race on authenticated screens: /app/frontend/app/contract/[id].tsx (line 108, useEffect(()=>load(),[load])) and /app/frontend/app/contracts/index.tsx (line 43, useFocusEffect load) fire before AuthContext has hydrated the token on hard reload. Gate on `!loading` from useAuth or retry when user becomes truthy. Low prio - only affects deep-links / hard-refresh; SPA nav is unaffected.
server.py grew again to 1812 lines (v6 was 1554). Splitting into routers (auth, projects, messaging, admin, maps, community, ai, product_prices, assistant, contracts) is now overdue.
ContractCreate.deposit_percent has no field-level validation - the same clamp in PUT (max(0, min(100, int))) should be applied on POST to prevent absurd values on creation.

GET /api/contracts (list) currently returns messages excluded ({_id:0, messages:0}) which is correct, but GET /api/contracts/{id} returns full messages array with no pagination - fine now, will need limit/offset once discussions grow.

public_contract(c) does not strip sensitive fields - customer_phone/contractor_phone are exposed to whoever can read the contract (fine for the two parties; verify admins reading via list are expected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 1812 lines - refactor overdue (identical comment as v6).

public_contract() only drops _id; consider excluding customer_phone/contractor_phone from list responses (they're already excluded from list via projection but not from single-contract read for admin).
PUT /contracts/{id} always resets signatures even when NO editable field is provided in the body (e.g. `PUT {}` still wipes signatures). Guard: only reset if updates dict is non-empty.

POST /contracts/{id}/sign: `is_customer = c.get('customer_id') == user['user_id']` means a non-customer user with role='customer' who accesses via _contract_or_404 (they can't - 403) would be treated as contractor side. Access control is fine here, just noting the tight coupling.
Contracts screen useEffect fires load() unconditionally on mount; needs to wait on AuthContext.loading (see integration_issue).
